profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Video & Edge Computing @ Alocity | NVIDIA Jetson · VLMs | Healthcare & MedTech Architecture
profile.summary:
I build systems where software meets the physical world, in environments where reliability actually matters.
At Alocity I work on the AI side of a physical security platform: real-time video intelligence, vision-language models running on NVIDIA Jetson at the edge, and agentic AI tooling. My work spans device integration, backend services, model deployment, and getting things into production.
Before that, [15+] years in healthcare and MedTech building low-latency video systems, embedded hardware integrations, and Java and Python backends where failure has real consequences. I've modernized Java EE monoliths, authored Design History Files, and shipped under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485, which taught me to build systems that are not just fast, but traceable, secure, and defensible.
Strongest in: real-time video pipelines, hardware and software integration, edge AI deployment, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic tooling, backend architecture and refactoring legacy code into something maintainable.
Always up for a conversation about AI, computer vision, and edge systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Medical Devices)
positions.locationName: Boca Raton, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed Java and Android applications for FDA-regulated superficial radiation therapy (SRT) medical devices in a highly controlled environment. Worked across product development, quality assurance, and regulatory documentation.

Key Contributions:

•  Remote Support Platform: Architected a cross-platform remote assistance solution for medical devices (Android host + Windows JavaFX host/client) featuring RTSP/RTSPS screen streaming via FFmpeg/MediaMTX and a Node.js WebSocket/REST mediator on AWS for session orchestration. Built normalized coordinate event routing for remote clicks/touches/keyboard, added session lifecycle controls (authorize/cancel/timeout), and implemented resiliency features (connection monitoring + automatic reconnection) with user-visible state management.
•  Low-Latency Live RTSP Player (Android): Developed a low-latency live RTSP player for Android, enabling real-time patient observation and capture of high-resolution lesion images. Implemented a hybrid playback approach combining native Android media components (ExoPlayer) with an open-source RTSP pipeline (LibVLC) to improve stream stability. Tuned buffering/latency settings, added resilient reconnect and error handling.
•  Regulatory Documentation & Compliance: Updated Design History Files (DHF) for legacy medical devices to meet FDA 510(k) and EU MDR requirements. Created comprehensive technical documentation including requirements traceability, risk analysis (ISO 14971), and verification/validation protocols aligned with IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 standards. 
•  Clinical Tools Modernization: Upgraded internal clinical calculation tools by implementing improved dose accuracy models, optimizing user workflows (reducing calculation time by 50%) while ensuring full QMS compliance. 
•  VR Training Integration: Built proof-of-concept bridge between virtual reality training environments and physical radiation therapy systems, enabling safe operator training through simulated interactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Hospital Information Systems)
positions.description:
•  Healthcare System Architecture & Integration: Engineered complex adaptation of a mature, multi-national Hospital Information System to meet Cuban national healthcare standards. Performed deep architectural refactoring of Java EE (JBoss Seam) monolith, implementing granular customization layers to support distinct clinical workflows while maintaining core system stability across several healthcare facilities. 
•  Clinical Business Logic & Reporting: Designed and implemented complex clinical business rules using the Drools Business Rules Management System, and crafted automated, highly detailed medical reports using JasperReports.
•  Healthcare Interoperability & Standards: Implemented HL7 v2/v3 and Clinical Document Architecture (CDA) standards to ensure seamless data exchange between multiple clinical systems. Designed and maintained Electronic Health Record (EHR) components focusing on data integrity, patient record accuracy, and regulatory compliance with ICD-9 classification standards.
•  Database Design & Optimization: Managed complex database schemas using PostgreSQL and MySQL, including DDL/DML operations, stored procedures, and query optimization for high-volume clinical data. Designed efficient data models for patient records, clinical encounters, laboratory results, and medical imaging metadata.
•  Agile Development & Stakeholder Collaboration: Managed full SDLC from requirements gathering with medical staff and hospital administrators to deployment, testing, and production support. Collaborated with physicians, nurses, and administrative personnel to translate complex clinical workflows into technical specifications. Conducted system training and provided ongoing technical support.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Development · Core Java · Code Refactoring

positions.title: Lead Media Architect & Engineer
positions.description:
•	Founder & Sole Architect of Campus Streaming Platform: Conceptualized and built a proprietary "Netflix-style" VOD and live-streaming solution in 2004 (predating YouTube and modern streaming standards). Successfully deployed the platform to distribute educational content and live TV channels to the university network as a single-developer project.
•	Infrastructure Management: Managed the full stack of media delivery and streaming, including SAN storage, FTP servers, and video compression pipelines, serving thousands of concurrent student users.
•	Systems Security & Administration: Managed endpoint security and OS hardening for a mixed fleet of Windows/Linux workstations. Enforced security policies, patch management, and threat mitigation to ensure network integrity across the department.
